scenarios.question: Compare attempt success for 2026-10-01 inclusive to 2026-10-15 exclusive versus 2026-10-15 inclusive to 2026-10-29 exclusive in Asia/Kolkata. Explain bank/method contributions and observed failure labels.

facts: Method partition: mix contribution +0.0000 pp; within-segment contribution -1.8000 pp.
Joint partition: mix contribution +0.0000 pp; within-segment contribution -1.8000 pp.
Largest negative within-segment contribution: BANK_B / UPI, -1.8000 pp.
Largest recorded failure-label count increase: BANK_B / UPI / BANK_TIMEOUT, 5 to 185 (+180). Counts also depend on traffic volume.
hypotheses: Failure labels identify observations to investigate; they do not establish an infrastructure root cause.
recommendations: Inspect corresponding operational logs before making a causal or routing decision.
caveats: Denominator: all completed attempts in each explicit window and selected filters.
Attempt success does not measure order conversion or settlement completion.
Mix and within effects use symmetric midpoint weights; do not sum overlapping partitions.
